name: Faith Loss is Doubled/Gains Halved
description: Every believer's Faith moves each age unit by a few small rolls (New Believers' own Faith drift). This doubles the chance of every roll that takes Faith away and halves the chance of every roll that gives it: food under 10 loses 1 Faith 60% of the time (was 30%), and when that misses, 20% (was 10%); food 10 to 250 loses 1 Faith 20% of the time (was 10%); a sick believer loses 1 more 30% of the time (was 15%); fewer than 12 believers loses 1 with a chance of 2 x (12 - believers) in 100 (was 12 - believers). Food 8,000 or more gains 1 Faith 10% of the time (was 20%); the Tribute Statue solved 15% (was 30%; its first and second stages 5% and 10%, were 10% and 20%); Spirituality 1, 2 or 3 gains 5%, 10% or 15% (was 10%, 20% or 30%); 12 or more believers gains 1 with a chance of believers / 10 in 100 (was believers / 5). A fall is no longer skipped half the time when Faith is below 5, so a believer can fall all the way to 0 and become a Heathen, as in the stock game at 0; a rise above 75 is still skipped 70% of the time. Preaching, Spreading the Word, island events and every other Faith change are unchanged. Adds a real chance of your villagers becoming heathens. Makes the game that much harder. Good Luck!
behavior_changes: The Faith drift 0x468040 (each believer, once per age unit, live and while catching up; Heathens skipped at 0x472CB7): every loss roll's rand(100) threshold doubled, every gain roll's halved, and the 50% skip of a fall below Faith 5 (0x4681A7) removed. The rise skip above 75 (70%) is unchanged.
A believer whose Faith reaches 0 or less becomes a Heathen in the setter 0x467F90, exactly as in the stock game.
explicit_non_changes: Thirteen immediates and branches inside the routine; no code is added and no executable space is claimed.
Starting Faith, preaching, Spreading the Word, the Heathen Doctor's cure, The Heathen Chief, the Hydroponic Farm, the Heathen Mommy's puzzle and island events are unchanged.

patches.purpose: food 10..250 (and food under 10 when its first roll missed): -1 on rand(100) < 10 -> < 20
the Tribute Statue solved: +1 on rand(100) < 30 -> < 15
the statue's second stage: +1 on rand(100) < 20 -> < 10
the statue's first stage: +1 on rand(100) < 10 -> < 5
fewer than 12 believers: -1 on rand(100) < 12 - n -> imul ecx,edi,-2 / add ecx,24 / cmp eax,ecx: < 2 * (12 - n)
12 or more believers: +1 on rand(100) < n / 5 -> sar edx,2: < n / 10 (n is positive here, so the sign fix-up is not needed)
a fall with Faith under 5 was skipped on rand(100) < 50: jge -> jmp, never skipped
